paraphrase: In the examination of the Word-brahman Śāntarakṣita argues that an eternal, single Word-brahman cannot account for successive and various things: if the world were its transformation it would be non-eternal and many; if it were only its appearance, the appearance would be unreal and the Word-brahman unproved; and no means of knowledge shows that cognition is interwoven with words.
notes: Argument summarized from memory; verse numbers not fixed.
